newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania wins Belgian order for 114 trucks.
newsitem.headline: Scania wins Belgian order for 114 trucks.

text.p: Swedish truck maker Scania said on Tuesday that it had won an order to supply 114 of its four-series trucks to Belgian transporters Dirk and Luc Callant.
Scania said in a statement that the Callants operated three transportation firms -- North Sea Express, Dirk Callant Transport and Luc Callant Forwarding.
It gave no financial details about the order.
Scania said it had a 20 percent market share in Belgium, where it registered 1,245 trucks in 1996 compared to 1,406 the year. At the same time the total market declined by 11.5 percent.
